title: Repository links and code index
description: Use when LPM code evidence is missing or stale (no_active_index, scan older than 24 h, índice de código desatualizado): link a GitHub repository to a project or workspace, scan it, refresh, activate, roll back or purge the code index, or compare commits. Not for code questions (use lpm-ask-advisor).
doneWhen: The repository is linked and its active index version is at the expected commit, verified by a status read and a smoke search.
authorityCeiling: Reads and scans are [A]; links, refresh, activate, rollback and purge are [C]; index caps are the owner's financial decision.
jobs: the Advisor says no_active_index for repository <url>: fix it
is the code index current for the workspace repositories?
link a repository to project <name>: https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>
o índice de código está desatualizado? escaneie o repositório do projeto
roll back the code index to the previous version
compare commits <base> and <head> of the repository
purge the old code index version <versionId>

notFor.when: asking what the code does, where something is, or a roadmap item's technical impact
a GitHub token, the workspace GitHub credential or an API key
index caps, code-search quota or the AI budget
a commit that delivers an activity (LPM-Activity trailer)
creating and kicking off a new project

sharedRefs.name: error-codes
sharedRefs.loadWhen: an error code or message is not in §9

references.loadWhen: playbook check: is the code index current, stale or missing; no_active_index
playbook link: link a new GitHub repository to the workspace or a project
playbook scan: scan a linked repository (branch, commit, languages)
playbook refresh: build and activate a new code index (missing or stale)
playbook rollback: put the previous code index version back
playbook purge: delete the content of one old index version
playbook compare: list files changed between two commits
playbook change-link: change branch or project mappings, or unhide a link
playbook unlink: archive a link, or hide it from agents
background facts: index states, caps, limits

codex.shortDescription: Link repos and keep the LPM code index fresh
codex.defaultPrompt: Use $lpm-code-index to check and refresh the LPM code index of repository <url>.
